_readme: Hindcast discipline. Every hindcast lake has an explicit pre-event-only
cutoff; no scene acquired after a lake's cutoff may enter the screening
decision for that lake. Enforced in code by the Stage 1 fetcher (which
refuses to tag a post-cutoff scene as pre-event) and re-checked by the
Stage 7 harness before it scores anything.
TWO kinds of date live here, and conflating them is the classic leakage bug:
cutoff        - the last date whose data may inform the SCREENING decision
post_event_ok - post-event scenes ARE fetched and committed, because
Stage 3's burst detector must see the area drop. They are
tagged post_event and are invisible to Stage 7.
Non-event lakes are screened at each event's decision date so the confusion
matrix compares like with like: 'on the day we had to judge Thame, what did
each system flag?' rather than mixing epochs.

thame_2024.note: The headline confusion matrix is computed at this date. Growth-only must miss thyanbo_tsho here while the proxy-augmented model catches it.

rasuwa_2025.event: Pyurepu supraglacial outburst / Lhende Khola, 8 Jul 2025

chamoli_2021.event: Chamoli rock-and-ice avalanche, 7 Feb 2021 (NOT a GLOF)

calibration_policy.rationale: Thresholds are frozen against a growth-only-catchable positive (South Lhonak) and the negative control (Chamoli) before either Nepal case is touched. Tuning on Thame would make the headline result circular.

thyanbo_tsho.reason: GLOF at ~05:00 NPT on 16 Aug 2024. Last usable pre-event Sentinel-2 acquisition in the published record is 2024-07-30.
thyanbo_tsho.post_event_reason: Stage 3 burst detection needs the 2024-09-18 scene, where the published NDWI area drops 71.5% (43,902 -> 12,516 m2).

south_lhonak.post_event_reason: Calibrates the sudden-drop detector against the documented 15.38% post-burst area loss (1.69 -> 1.46 km2).

pyurepu_supraglacial.reason: Drained within a single day, 8 Jul 2025. The lake reached maximum extent on 7 Jul, so the cutoff keeps exactly one day of margin.
pyurepu_supraglacial.post_event_reason: The 7 Jul to 8 Jul drop is the fastest transition in the set and stress-tests the detector at daily resolution.

chamoli_ronti.post_event_reason: Needed to confirm the pipeline does NOT report a lake-area drop here, because there was no lake to drain.
